_comment: Business and regional country groups. Geographic groups (continents, UN M49 regions) are generated from GeoNames and CLDR; political groups with dates live in memberships.json. Business groups have no single authority: each lists its definition so users can judge it, and expandGroups(['cee', 'AT']) adds anything a team counts differently.

groups.name: DACH
groups.definition: German-speaking core of Europe: Germany (D), Austria (A), Switzerland (CH), plus Liechtenstein.

groups.name: Nordic countries
groups.definition: Nordic Council: Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden and the autonomous Faroe Islands, Greenland and Åland.

groups.name: Central and Eastern Europe (CEE)
groups.definition: Former Eastern Bloc and Yugoslav states in Europe (OECD-style CEE), plus Ukraine, Belarus and Moldova.

groups.name: Eastern Europe (broad)
groups.definition: Broad business definition: UN M49 Eastern Europe, the Baltic states, the Balkans and the South Caucasus.

groups.name: EMEA
groups.definition: Europe, the Middle East and Africa: UN M49 Europe, Africa and Western Asia, plus Kosovo and Iran.

groups.name: MENA
groups.definition: Middle East and North Africa (World Bank region).

groups.name: Asia-Pacific (APAC)
groups.definition: UN M49 Eastern, South-eastern and Southern Asia and Oceania, without Iran (counted in MENA).

groups.name: North America (business)
groups.definition: UN M49 Northern America plus Mexico (NAFTA/USMCA area).

groups.name: Latin America and the Caribbean
groups.definition: UN M49 Latin America and the Caribbean (419).
